items.rationale: The context window is what the model sees in one call, bounded in tokens. Option b treats the model as learning from use; c and d confuse it with saved records and tools.
Call 1: 2,000. Call 2: 3,000. Call 3: 4,000. Total 9,000. An answer of 5,000 forgets that the whole list is resent every call.
Nothing persists between sessions unless saved outside the context and loaded back. A larger window or a prompt instruction cannot recall a closed session.
